comparison.objective: Position shielding between two hazards and a seat versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Geometric placement, upright stabilization, and inter-arm brick handoff versus recessed-tool engagement, counterhold, fine tuning, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Each brick upright on the vial-seat line within 12 cm without touching vials versus two non-bottoming stops without overload, rebound, or drift.
comparison.reason: Spatial shielding placement and handoff test a separate ability from damper adjustment.
